National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is empowered under the Customs Act to formulate and notify new rules by repealing previous ones.
Customs Act 1969: This Act provides the legal authority for the National Board of Revenue to issue rules and notifications regarding customs procedures. The power is exercised under the relevant section of the Act, read in conjunction with the specified Third Schedule.
Third Schedule: The Third Schedule of the Customs Act is cited as part of the legal basis for the issuance of this regulatory order.
Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import): These existing rules are formally repealed by the National Board of Revenue to make way for new baggage import regulations.

(৬) একজন বিদেশী পাসপোর্টধারী যাত্রী এক লিটার পর্যন্ত মদ বা মদ জাতীয় পানীয় (যেমন-স্পিরিট, বিয়ার, ইত্যাদি) সকল প্রকার শুল্ক ও কর পরিশোধ ব্যতিরেকে আমদানি করিতে পারিবেন।
(৭) কোন যাত্রী তফসিল-২ এবং তফসিল-৩ এ উল্লিখিত পণ্য বিদেশ হইতে সঙ্গে না আনিয়া থাকিলে তফসিল-৪ এ বিধৃত ফরমে উল্লেখক্রমে তাহা বাংলাদেশ পর্যটন কর্পোরেশনের সিটি সেলস্ সেন্টার হইতে যাত্রী আগমনের ৭ (সাত) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে ক্রয় করিতে পারিবেন।

Passenger Baggage Allowance: Passengers aged twelve and above arriving by air or water may import up to sixty-five kilograms of accompanied baggage, such as handbags or cabin bags, free of all duties and taxes.
In addition to the base allowance, passengers may import up to thirty-five kilograms of personal items including clothing, toiletries, books, and study materials free of duties and taxes.
Passengers under twelve years of age are entitled to import up to forty kilograms of personal baggage free of duties and taxes, and they are not eligible for any other baggage concessions.
Professionally used, portable equipment imported by a passenger may be cleared free of all customs duties and taxes.
Baggage Declaration: Unaccompanied baggage must be declared using the prescribed form in the first schedule to qualify for duty-free clearance, and a copy of this declaration must be submitted to the customs officer during the clearance process.
Passenger Baggage Purchase Form: Passengers who did not bring items listed in the second and third schedules with them upon arrival may purchase these goods from designated duty-free centers within a specific timeframe after arrival by using the form prescribed in the fourth schedule.
Duty-Free Baggage: Passengers may import one unit of each item listed in the third schedule duty-free, with a specific allowance of two units for mobile phones.
Foreign passport holders are permitted to import up to one liter of alcoholic beverages duty-free.
Gold jewelry up to a specific weight limit, not exceeding twelve pieces, or silver jewelry up to a specified weight, may be imported duty-free by passengers.
Goods listed in the second schedule may be imported by passengers upon payment of applicable duties and taxes.
Baggage: Gold or silver bars or bullions up to a defined weight limit may be imported by passengers upon arrival in Bangladesh, subject to the payment of applicable customs duties and taxes.

Green Channel: Passengers who are not carrying any goods liable to duties and taxes may utilize the green channel at the airport if it is available.
Customs officers may perform scanning and physical examination of baggage for a portion of passengers passing through the green channel based on random selection.
Regardless of standard procedural rules, customs officers reserve the authority to scan and examine the baggage of any passenger using the green channel if they have reasonable grounds for suspicion.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: Customs officers are empowered to conduct random screening of a specified percentage of passengers using the green channel.
Customs officers retain the authority to examine any passenger's baggage at the green channel whenever there is a reasonable suspicion of an offence.

(৩) ভুলবশতঃ অথবা অন্য কোন অনিবার্য কারণে উপ-বিধি (১) ও উপ-বিধি (২) এর বিধান মোতাবেক কোন যাত্রী কর্তৃক ঘোষণা প্রদান করা সম্ভব না হইলে আগমনের ৭ (সাত) দিনের মধ্যে সংশ্লিষ্ট অ্যাসিস্টেন্ট কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস এর নিম্নে নহেন এমন কাস্টমস কর্মকর্তার নিকট তফসিল-১ এ বর্ণিত ফরম পূরণ করিয়া তিনি ব্যাগেজ ঘোষণা প্রদান করিতে পারিবেন।
(৪) একজন যাত্রী ১ (এক) পঞ্জিকা বৎসরে মাত্র ১ (এক) বার unaccompanied baggage আনিতে পারিবেন।

Baggage Declaration: All passengers arriving from abroad must submit a baggage declaration to the customs authority using the form specified in the relevant schedule.
For unaccompanied baggage, the passenger is required to submit the declaration using the specified form before departing from the customs hall or designated customs area.

In cases where a declaration cannot be made upon arrival due to error or unavoidable circumstances, the passenger may submit the required form within a specified timeframe to a customs officer at or above the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs.
Baggage: A passenger is permitted to import unaccompanied baggage only once within a single calendar year.
Customs Authority: The customs authority is the designated entity to receive baggage declarations from passengers arriving from abroad or those declaring unaccompanied baggage.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: An officer of or above the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs is authorized to accept delayed baggage declarations when passengers fail to report their items upon initial arrival due to error or unavoidable circumstances.

Passenger Baggage: The baggage of a Bangladeshi citizen who dies abroad is granted a complete exemption from all types of customs duties and taxes.

Commercial Baggage Import: Passengers importing goods in commercial quantities that are not covered under specified schedules may clear them subject to the presentation of clearance from the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
The clearance of such goods is conditional upon the completion of adjudication proceedings and the payment of all applicable customs duties, taxes, penalties, and fines.
Adjudication of Customs Cases: Adjudication is required to determine the liability and applicable charges for passengers importing goods in commercial quantities beyond the limits defined in the relevant schedules.

Red Channel: Passengers who answer yes to any of the declaration form's criteria concerning restricted or dutiable goods are required to report to the customs officer stationed at the Red Channel.

Assistant Revenue Officer of Customs: This officer is responsible for signing the product purchase form to verify the customs declaration made by the passenger.
Assistant Commissioner of Customs: The Assistant or Deputy Commissioner of Customs is required to sign and seal the purchase form to validate the clearance process.
National Board of Revenue: This body issues the orders and regulatory forms governing the purchase and declaration of goods by arriving passengers.
Passenger Baggage: Passengers are required to purchase declared goods within a specific period after their arrival. The Customs officer determines the eligibility of these goods by coordinating them with the items already brought by the passenger under the relevant schedules of the rules.
